description: assainissement collectif is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition écologique. Information on collection networks and wastewater treatment plants in urban sewerage centres in metropolitan areas and overseas departments. Coverage: Ministère de la Transition écologique. The portal shows the English title as "collective sanitation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministère de la Transition écologique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ODS, CSV. The listing shows 2016-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
